room_rent.note: Policy wording does not mention any room rent cap or category restriction; Schedule of Benefits does not list a room rent sub-limit, suggesting actuals/no cap, but it is not explicitly stated.

icu.note: No ICU charge cap mentioned anywhere in the policy wording or Schedule of Benefits.

copayment.note: Co-pay applies only to insured persons covered for the first time in Health Total at those ages; no co-pay for younger entry-age members. Applies to all benefits except Benefit 13 (OPD).

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped at 10% of SI per eye, max ₹1L/eye; maternity sub-limits; domiciliary capped at 10% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 10% of SI per eye, max ₹1,00,000/eye. Maternity: ₹15,000–₹1,00,000 depending on plan/SI. Domiciliary: up to 10% of SI. Patient care: per-day limits. Emergency evacuation: up to 5% of SI.

deductible.note: No compulsory deductible. A voluntary deductible can be opted for a premium discount; it applies per hospitalisation claim under Benefit 1.

initial_waiting.note: 30-day waiting period for illnesses on fresh proposals; not applicable for accidental hospitalisation.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 24 months of continuous coverage. In year 3, PED claims paid at 50%; from year 4 onwards at 100%. Reducible via portability credit.

specific_disease_waiting.display: 24 months (most listed conditions); 36 months (joint replacement, organ transplant, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, osteoporosis)
specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, BPH, hydrocele, sinuses, fistulae, haemorrhoids, fibroids, stones, varicose veins, etc. 36-month list includes organ transplant, joint replacement, rheumatoid arthritis, gout, osteoporosis.

maternity.note: Dependent spouse: 24 months continuous coverage + 3 annual premiums. Primary insured (female): 36 months + 4 annual premiums. Sub-limits: normal delivery ₹15,000–₹50,000; LSCS ₹25,000–₹1,00,000 depending on plan/SI. Pre/post-natal hospitalisation covered under Superior & Premiere plans only.

cumulative_bonus.note: 50% of base SI added per claim-free year; maximum cumulative bonus capped at 100% of first-year SI. If a claim is made, bonus reduces by 50% of SI in the next year but not below base SI.

restoration.note: Restore SI equals 100% of base SI (excluding cumulative bonus). Triggered only after full SI + cumulative bonus exhausted. Cannot be used for the same illness/complication already claimed in that year, or for maternity. Only once per policy year; not carried forward.

pre_hosp.note: 60 days pre-hospitalisation expenses covered across all plans and sum insured options.

post_hosp.note: Vital Plan (₹3L–₹5L): 90 days. Superior Plan (₹10L): 90 days; (₹15L–₹25L): 120 days. Premiere Plan (₹50L–₹1Cr): 180 days.

day_care.note: Annexure I lists 409 specific day-care procedures. Policy also states any other surgery/procedure agreed by insurer requiring <24 hrs hospitalisation due to technological advancement is covered.

domiciliary.note: Covered for illnesses lasting at least 3 days. Several conditions excluded from domiciliary cover (asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, etc.).

ayush.note: Ayurveda, Yoga & Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy covered for hospitalisation in government or QCI/NABH-accredited institutions. OPD AYUSH excluded. Pre/post-hospitalisation and AYUSH day care also covered per footnote amendment.

organ_donor.note: Harvesting expenses of organ donor covered subject to Transplantation of Human Organs Act compliance. Donor screening, pre/post-hospitalisation for donor, and organ acquisition costs excluded.

ambulance.note: Vital Plan: up to ₹1,500 per hospitalisation. Superior/Premiere Plan: actuals for network hospitals; up to ₹2,000–₹10,000 for non-network depending on plan and individual/floater option.

modern_treatments.note: Policy does not explicitly mention modern/robotic treatments as a named benefit. Day-care list includes advanced procedures (stereotactic radiosurgery, VMAT, robotic-type oncology treatments, etc.) which may be covered under day-care or inpatient benefits.

consumables.note: Annexure III lists extensive non-medical/consumable items (gloves, masks, ECG electrodes, etc.) as excluded. No consumables rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Medical Treatment Abroad available only under Premiere Plan (₹50L and ₹1Cr SI) after 36 months continuous coverage. Covers 8 specific major procedures (CABG, organ transplant, bone marrow transplant, craniotomy for cancer, etc.). Reimbursement in INR only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium payment mode and 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period unless premium paid in instalments during policy period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines. Accrued waiting period credits transferred. Applicable for Benefits 1–4 waiting periods; maternity benefit waiting period not portable.

notable_exclusions.display: Consumables (gloves, masks, etc.), durable medical equipment, STDs (non-HIV), external congenital anomaly, stem cell storage, hormone replacement therapy, refractive error <7.5D, IVF/ART

optional_riders.display: Voluntary deductible (premium discount), OPD cover (Superior/Premiere plans), child vaccination (Premiere), medical treatment abroad (Premiere)
